ext.description: SOVEREIGN in your editor — ask about the current file or selection, explain code, fix diagnostics and write tests.
view.container.title: SOVEREIGN
view.chat.name: Chat
cmd.writeTest: Write a test for this function
cfg.baseUrl: SOVEREIGN server address. Only `https://` is accepted (plus `http://localhost` for development).
cfg.model: Model id from the SOVEREIGN catalogue, or `auto` to let the server choose.
cfg.maxContextLines: Maximum number of lines sent around the selection. The whole workspace is never sent.
cfg.language: Interface language of the SOVEREIGN panel. `auto` follows the editor display language.
cfg.telemetry: Off by default. The extension collects no telemetry; this switch exists so the answer stays explicit.
